Messages.Author: David Wilson
Messages.Body:
Hello LSJ,

If a vampire of capacity above 7 has the Soul Gem of Etrius is burned and
you also have the Virolax Facility in play, can you choose the order of
effects?

I read the texts of the card and it does not appear that either card takes
precedence, so I assume as with other effects, you may choose the order that
they happen.

thanks,

David Wilson

Messages.Body:

Yes. Not that it should matter much, unless you've some way to look at
the top card of your crypt beforehand.

Google: "Soul Gem Virolax author:LSJ"

> I read the texts of the card and it does not appear that either card
takes

that

Yes.
